en: Black‑and‑white view over a small fishing harbor filled with wooden boats and sheds, with clusters of wooden houses climbing the rocky shoreline. In the foreground are boathouses and moored sailing vessels; behind them, tightly packed homes stand against a backdrop of low, bare rocky hills. The word "HOVENÄSET" appears in the lower left, and a small triangular publisher's mark with text is in the lower right.
